title: Crude Oil Blockade Line Traffic Declines to 7.54 Mbpd Over 28-Day Period
summary: TankerTrackers reports significant reduction in crude oil shipments via USN Blockade Line, averaging 7.54 million barrels per day over the past 28 days, down from 17.67 Mbpd in January-February 2026.
contents: Fresh figures show substantial change in global crude oil transport patterns. Over the complete 28-day measurement period, six days recorded more than 10 million barrels of crude oil departing via the USN Blockade Line. The average daily throughput stands at 7.54 million barrels per day (Mbpd), representing a decline from 17.67 Mbpd observed during January and February 2026. This reduction indicates shifting geopolitical dynamics affecting energy shipment routes and sanctions enforcement mechanisms. The data reflects evolving patterns in crude export flows through critical maritime chokepoints, with implications for global energy security and sanctions compliance monitoring. Tanker tracking intelligence continues documenting these movements across strategic shipping lanes and restricted transit zones.

title: Two Seafarers Killed in Strait of Hormuz Tanker Attack
summary: A tanker vessel came under attack in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in the deaths of two seafarers.
contents: A maritime security incident occurred in the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical chokepoints for global oil transport. A tanker vessel experienced an attack that resulted in the loss of two seafarers. This incident underscores the ongoing security concerns in the Persian Gulf region, a strategic waterway through which approximately one-third of global maritime oil trade passes. The attack represents a continuation of maritime security threats in the area, affecting commercial shipping operations and international maritime safety. Such incidents highlight vulnerabilities in global shipping corridors and the persistent geopolitical tensions affecting maritime commerce in the Middle East.

title: US Seals Major Venezuela Oil Deal
summary: Fox News reports on a landmark oil agreement signing between the United States and Venezuela.
contents: The United States sealed a major oil agreement with Venezuela, marking a significant diplomatic and economic development. The landmark signing represents a substantial shift in bilateral relations and energy cooperation between the two nations. This development comes amid ongoing geopolitical tensions in Latin America and reflects changing dynamics in US foreign policy toward the region. The agreement signals potential economic opportunities for both countries and may have broader implications for energy markets and Western Hemisphere stability.
